zara_ops: Alert: FRA rack cooling spike this morning, 3 nodes in rack-12 tripped. Observed inconsistent fan speeds and two H100s in thermal-derate. Losing ~25% capacity on that pod.
jonathan_procurement: Thanks. Reached out to GalaxCo support 30m ago. Their field response says replacement units available but lead time 10-14 business days. They offered an expedited air option (3-4 days) with a 7% expedite surcharge.
tom_sre: Do we have mitigation runway? We can rebalance inference shards to other EU pods, but p99 latency will increase for edge chat for a subset of customers. I can circuit-breakchatter for non-critical tenants.
ashley_logistics: GalaxCo RMA checklist: serial, depot photo set, error logs, host ID. They require manifest upload to vendor portal before they release loaner AWB.
galaxco_rep: Hi team - we can issue 1 loaner per failed unit for up to 10 days on expedite. For full-swap new units ETA 3 business days outbound + customs time. If customer provides pre-cleared broker details we can push customs priority.
zara_ops: Do we want loaners to keep capacity while full replacements arrive? Last time loaners had to be returned in original packing which slowed depot throughput.
jonathan_procurement: Two options: (1) Accept expedite + loaners now; infra pays 7% expedite and covers additional handling fee (~€1,200) OR (2) accept on-refurb sea shipment in ~12 days, vendor offsets 3% credit on unit price. Which minimizes SLA impact?
tom_sre: Option 1 reduces SLA risk for interactive endpoints. Option 2 acceptable for non-interactive batch workloads. We have three enterprise customers on low-latency contracts94they'll see degraded tail if we choose 2.
cecilia_finance: Need an exact cost delta to sign off. Jonathan, drop the PO and a line-itemed cost breakdown here. Finance needs cost center tag.
jonathan_procurement: PO drafted: PO-8899. Line items: expedite fee 7% (~€9,100), handling €1,200, loaner shipping prepay €420. Unit credit if refurbished chosen: -3% per unit. Tagging cost center: infra-eu-prod.
ashley_logistics: If we do expedite, send serials & photos within 2h. Depot access team can snapshot and upload manifest. Use photo checklist: `serial`, `label_top`, `label_bottom`, `PCI_evidence`, `fan_log`. Upload to portal and cc ops@redwood.ai.
vendorbot: Tracking note: provisional AWB FR555000111 scheduled pickup 2026-03-26 09:30 CET. Customs docs pending, broker on file: RapidClear Ltd.
alzara: (typo) sorry meant zara_ops: If RapidClear is our broker we can expedite clearance. Liability: vendor keeps warranty assignment per contract.
jonathan_procurement: GalaxCo is willing to split expedite fee 50/50 if we sign to a temporary extended warranty extension of 3 months after swap. They propose a vendor credit note to offset half expedite.
cecilia_finance: 50/50 split ok if guaranteed loaner delivery SLA is met. Include credit note terms in PO. Finance will expedite sign-off once terms in writing.
galaxco_rep: Confirming: we can provide a 50% expedite credit (applied as invoice credit) if PO includes a 3-month warranty extension clause and return logistics covered by Redwood. Will provide written addendum within 2 hours.
tom_sre: Mitigation plan: (A) Shift non-critical traffic to AMS dedicated pool (expected +15ms p99), (B) redistribute shards in EU pod and increase KV priming to 1.4x to reduce cold-token regen. I'll push `service.runtime.kv.priming=1.4` during maintenance window 01:30-02:00 CET.
zara_ops: Action items: Jonathan - confirm PO addendum and vendor credit; Ashley - coordinate depot photo upload and inbound slot; Tom - schedule runtime change and monitor p99 dashboards; Cecilia - finance sign-off on cost-split.
jonathan_procurement: I uploaded PO-8899 to procurement system and attached vendor addendum draft. Pushed for written confirmation from GalaxCo.
ashley_logistics: Depot team will collect serials by 11:00 CET and upload per checklist. I'll notify SOC to expect loaner pallet arrival and pre-stage.
vendorbot: Note: loaner AWB will be released once manifest uploaded and verified. ETA loaner AWB issuance: 24h after docs accepted.
cecilia_finance: Finance approves 50/50 expedite split pending the addendum language. Approver: cecilia_finance. Please finalize and I'll sign.
zara_ops: Good. We'll proceed with expedited + loaners under the credit split. I'll update the incident and route affected customers to degraded plan. Report any timeline slips in this thread.
jonathan_procurement: Final: PO-8899 signed with addendum. Vendor credit note will appear on next invoice. I'll attach AWB once received.
tom_sre: Starting KV priming change at 01:35 CET. Will monitor and roll back if error rate >0.5% or p99 >350ms.
ashley_logistics: Serial upload complete at 10:58 CET, manifest ID MNL-3347. Vendor portal confirmed.
vendorbot: AWB FR555000111 issued 2026-03-26 10:12 CET. Loaner pickup scheduled 2026-03-26 12:00 CET.
zara_ops: Thanks team. Closing loop: jonathan (PO & vendor credit), ashley (inbound staging), tom (runtime changes), cecilia (signed approval). We'll reconvene if AWB misses ETA.
